plan: Implement canvas-persistence: add canvasLayouts store to NovelDatabase (v6), define CanvasLayout extends VersionedRecord + CanvasNodeLayout generic type, add getCanvasLayout/saveCanvasLayout db helpers, write round-trip test verifying save→reload→restore and panelKey isolation.
actions: Added CanvasNodeLayout type to src/shared/canvas/types.ts (stripped-down node without domain data: id, kind, position, width, height, groupId).
Added CanvasPanelKey type and CanvasLayout interface to src/features/novel/types.ts (extends VersionedRecord: panelKey, viewport, nodes: CanvasNodeLayout[], edges: CanvasEdge[]).
Added V6_STORES to db-schema.ts with canvasLayouts store: 'id, projectId, panelKey, updatedAt, [projectId+panelKey]'. Bumped DB_VERSION to 6.
Added canvasLayouts EntityTable to NovelDatabase class in db.ts and registered v6 version.
Implemented getCanvasLayout(projectId, panelKey) — queries via [projectId+panelKey] composite index.
Implemented saveCanvasLayout(projectId, panelKey, data) — upserts layout (creates with recordBase if new, bumps revision if existing).

Updated db-schema.test.ts: DB_VERSION assertion 5→6, added V6_STORES canvasLayouts index test, added v6 open test (canvasLayouts table exists), added 2 round-trip tests (save→reload→restore with revision bump, panelKey isolation via composite index).
All 100 tests pass (3 new canvas persistence tests + 22 canvas core + 75 existing). tsc --noEmit clean.

verification.summary: vitest run: 13 files, 100 tests passed (3 new canvas persistence round-trip tests). canvasLayouts store opens at v6, save→reload→restore preserves viewport/nodes/edges, revision increments on update, panelKey isolation works via [projectId+panelKey] composite index.
tsc --noEmit: exit 0. CanvasLayout type, CanvasPanelKey, db helpers all type-check cleanly.

selfReflection: Canvas persistence is straightforward: CanvasLayout extends the existing VersionedRecord pattern, canvasLayouts store uses the same Dexie schema approach as other stores. The [projectId+panelKey] composite index ensures one layout per panel per project and enables efficient lookup. Domain data stays in existing tables (entities, timelineEvents, etc.); canvas only stores layout (position/size/viewport/edges). No architectural issues — ready for panel integration.

selfAssessment.reason: Persistence layer follows existing project conventions (VersionedRecord, Dexie stores, recordBase). Round-trip test verifies the full save→reload→restore cycle. No blockers for the 4 panel integrations.

nextDirection: Implement the first novel canvas panel: character relationships. Create a CharacterCanvasPanel component that renders StoryEntity (kind=character) nodes on InfiniteCanvas, connected by EntityRelation edges. Use CanvasNodeShell for node rendering with character-specific content (name, role, summary). Sync node positions with CanvasLayout persistence (panelKey='character-canvas'). Load entities via useLiveQuery, merge with saved layout positions. Then proceed to timeline, worldview, and planning canvas panels.
